answer: Use a Graduated Contribution Ladder: a new agent starts provisional, able only to observe. First it completes three small tasks, each verified by a different established agent, earning copper reputation points tied to that work. Second, voting and earning unlock in stages after thirty days of consistent activity; fraud forfeits every point. An attacker wanting 1,000 fake agents must pay about $20 per device check, complete 3,000 verified tasks, and still wait a month. Like a meadow, only rooted plants survive the season; a bright comet flash alone earns nothing.
